quote: Leveraging large language models (LLMs), we developed a framework to characterize stigma based on conceptualization of (labeling, stereotyping, separation, status loss, and discrimination) and transform them into more empathetic versions, resulting in 1,649 de-stigmatized pairs.
We leveraged large language models (LLMs) to ... transform stigmatizing language into more empathetic and inclusive ... resulting in 1,649 de‑stigmatized pairs.
Our objective is to determine which model is most effective at transforming stigmatizing language into expressions that are more empathetic and inclusive.
datasets: Reddit posts from r/unpopularopinion, r/offmychest, r/medicine, r/nursing
3,207 posts containing stigmatizing language towards people who use substances (PWUS)
outputs: de‑stigmatized text (original post paired with revised, less stigmatizing version)

quote: Automatic Evaluation. To further evaluate the stylistic similarity between original posts and their de-stigmatized counterparts generated by our models, we conducted a linguistic analysis using LIWC.

We conducted a stylistic similarity analysis using LIWC to compare original stigmatizing posts with their de‑stigmatized versions generated by our models... A pairwise two‑way t‑test showed no significant differences...

We conducted a stylistic similarity analysis using LIWC to compare original stigmatizing posts with their de-stigmatized versions generated by our top-rated system (Informed + Stylized GPT-4). A pairwise two-way t-test showed no significant differences in means across all LIWC variables between the two sets of posts.
Human Evaluation. To assess the effectiveness of our six systems ... we conducted a human evaluation with five reviewers ...
Human evaluation. To assess the effectiveness of our six systems ... we conducted a human evaluation with five reviewers on a random sample of 110 posts (a total of 660 generated texts).

To assess the effectiveness of our six systems (baseline, informed, and informed + stylized for GPT-4 and Llama3), we conducted a human evaluation with five reviewers on a random sample of 110 posts (a total of 660 generated texts).
guideline: Assess the overall quality of the generated text with respect to ... naturalness, cohesion, human-likeness, and overall coherence ... de-stigmatization ... faithfulness ...
Reviewers were instructed to rank systems on overall quality, de‑stigmatization, and faithfulness using criteria such as naturalness, cohesion, appropriateness, human‑likeness, and faithfulness.

Please read the original post and the generated posts from each of the six systems carefully. For each of the following questions, select the system that best represents your evaluation. Use the space provided for any additional comments you may have. Assess the overall quality of the generated text with respect to the following measures in addition to destigmatization and faithfulness: • Naturalness: The degree to which the output is likely to be used/chosen by a native speaker in the given context/situation. • Cohesion: The text should be a well-organized and coherent body of information, not just a dump of related information. Specifically, the sentences should be connected to one another, maintaining good information flow and logic. • Appropriateness: The degree to which the output as a whole is appropriate in the given context/situation. E.g., "does the text appropriately consider the parents' emotional state in the given scenario?" • Human-Likeness: The degree to which the output could have been produced by a human.
